_about: Cut 2's plane map (operator ruling F1, Train Q, 2026-11-01). grammar-cut reads it for every `@name` after whitespace: `rename` maps a plane, floor or slot name; `tagged` maps a `<name>-<tag>` prefix; `slug` strips the at-sign from a bag slug; `scopes` names the npm scopes a `@name/` keeps; `out` names what stays as written (npm scopes standing bare, Caddy/Verse/CSS/code syntax, external handles and quoted mentions). A handle `@name@host` strips to `name@host` with no entry. A name in none of these lists REDS the dry run.
